simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שִׁקּוּי (H8250) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: שִׁקּוּי (shiqqûwy) means a beverage ; moisture , i.e. (figuratively) refreshment First listed occurrence: Hos 2 7.

definitions.full: H8250. shiqquy שִׁקּוּי noun [masculine] drink (Ba § 102 d ); — ׳שׁ לְעַצְמוֺתֶיךָ Prov 3:8 drink (figurative for refreshment) to thy bones (compare verb Pu`al ); plural suffix שִׁקֻּוַי (Ol § 186 b ) Psa 102:10 (+ לֶחֶם v a ) שִׁקּוּיָ֑י Hosea 2:7 .
